overview_description.description: YouShift is an automated scheduling platform that simplifies shift management for healthcare professionals, leading to increased efficiency and improved work-life balance. By automating the complex process of shift assignments, YouShift considers staff preferences, availability, and compliance with work-hour regulations. This helps hospitals, clinics, and other healthcare organizations reduce administrative tasks and ensure optimal staffing levels, ultimately enhancing patient care.

product.name: YouShift Mobile Application
product.description: A mobile app that lets clinicians view schedules, manage availability, request time off, and trade shifts.
